# exp04 summary (auto-generated by analyze_forgetting.py)

Correlations over post-trained checkpoints; 95% CIs from 10000 checkpoint-bootstrap resamples (seed 0); LOO = leave-one-out range of Pearson r.

## Rules and expectations (pre-registered in RESULTS.md)

| rule | test | observed | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gate 1 | r(Δbpb_fresh, forgetting) ≥ 0.8 pass, ≥ 0.6 soft | r = 0.887 | **pass** |
| One-sidedness | abs r(Δbpb_fresh, gsm8k gain) < 0.3 and Gate 1 ≥ soft pass | r = 0.383; gate pass | **not shown** |
| E1 | 0.6 ≤ r(fresh, forgetting) < 0.8 | r = 0.887 | **not met** |
| E2 | r(fresh, gsm8k gain) < 0.3 | r = 0.383 | **not met** |
| E3 | r(enwik8, forgetting) ≥ r(fresh, forgetting) − 0.05 | enwik8 r = 0.949 vs fresh r = 0.887 | **met** |
| E4 | R1-Distill largest Δbpb_fresh and below the all-12 OLS line | largest: True; residual +2.13 points | **not met** |
| One-sidedness, chat-condition gain (gain measure changed after the run) | abs r(Δbpb_fresh, gsm8k gain, chat) < 0.3 and Gate 1 ≥ soft pass | r = -0.473; ρ = 0.077 | **not shown** |
| Gate 1 on Spearman (not pre-registered) | same thresholds on Spearman ρ | ρ = 0.671 | **soft pass** |
| Gate 1 without Qwen2.5-Math and R1-Distill (not pre-registered) | same thresholds on Pearson r, n = 10 | r = 0.317; ρ = 0.430 | **fail** |

## Threshold reading (not pre-registered)

Noise floor per checkpoint = 1.96 × √(SE_post² + SE_base²) of the 6-task mean, as % of the base score (median ±2.1%; conservative, it ignores that both models answer the same items).

- 8 of 12 checkpoints are inside their floor (largest |forgetting| 1.8%); the largest drift still inside is Δbpb_fresh +14.7%.
- Above it, every checkpoint is outside: Qwen3-1.7B (Δbpb +16.2%, forgetting +4.7%, floor ±2.1%); Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B (Δbpb +23.8%, forgetting +13.9%, floor ±2.1%); DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B (Δbpb +43.0%, forgetting +21.6%, floor ±2.1%).
- At or below it, outside the floor anyway: SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct (Δbpb +3.6%, forgetting +3.8%, floor ±2.1%).
- Contiguous reading: every checkpoint up to Δbpb +2.1% (5 of 12) is inside.
